title: electrive - BMW EVs gain Supercharger access in North America (2025-12-10)
notes: US access from 2025-12-10 for i4, i5, i7, iX via CCS-NACS adapter; "BMW-approved adapters will be sold as accessories from the second quarter of 2026"; native NACS from 2026 with the i5 M60. MINI and Rolls-Royce not mentioned.
